ID_MISSING.title: Missing customer ID
ID_MISSING.explanation: Every customer needs an ID so records can be told apart.

ID_DUPLICATE.title: Customer ID used twice
ID_DUPLICATE.explanation: Two or more rows share one ID. Each customer needs their own.

FIRST_NAME_SPACES.title: Extra spaces in first name
FIRST_NAME_SPACES.explanation: There are spaces before or after the name. We remove them.

LAST_NAME_SPACES.title: Extra spaces in last name
LAST_NAME_SPACES.explanation: There are spaces before or after the name. We remove them.

EMAIL_MISSING.title: Missing email
EMAIL_MISSING.explanation: The email is empty, so this customer can't be contacted.

EMAIL_INVALID.title: Email doesn't look right
EMAIL_INVALID.explanation: It is missing an '@' or the part after it, like '.com'.

EMAIL_DUPLICATE.title: Email shared by several customers
EMAIL_DUPLICATE.explanation: These rows use the same email (capital letters ignored). Merge them if they are one person, or correct the email.

DATE_MISSING.title: Missing sign-up date
DATE_MISSING.explanation: The date the customer signed up is empty.

DATE_NOT_REAL.title: Sign-up date doesn't exist
DATE_NOT_REAL.explanation: This day is not on the calendar, like 30 February, so we can't guess what was meant.

DATE_UNREADABLE.title: Sign-up date can't be read
DATE_UNREADABLE.explanation: We could not recognise this as a date.

DATE_FORMAT.title: Date in another format
DATE_FORMAT.explanation: Dates should be written year-month-day. We rewrite them for you.

COUNTRY_UNKNOWN.title: Unknown country
COUNTRY_UNKNOWN.explanation: We could not match this to a country. Please choose the right one.

COUNTRY_FORMAT.title: Country not a 2-letter code
COUNTRY_FORMAT.explanation: Countries are written as a 2-letter code (ISO 3166). We recognise names, other spellings and lower case, and swap in the code.

PLAN_MISSING.title: Missing plan
PLAN_MISSING.explanation: Each customer should be on free, pro or enterprise.

PLAN_UNKNOWN.title: Unknown plan
PLAN_UNKNOWN.explanation: The plan must be free, pro or enterprise. Please pick the right one.

PLAN_FORMAT.title: Plan in capitals or with spaces
PLAN_FORMAT.explanation: Plans are written in small letters without extra spaces. We tidy them up.

SPEND_MISSING.title: Missing monthly spend
SPEND_MISSING.explanation: The monthly spend is empty. Use 0 if the customer pays nothing.

SPEND_NOT_NUMBER.title: Spend isn't a number
SPEND_NOT_NUMBER.explanation: We need an amount here, like 49.50 or 0. Words like 'TBD' can't be used.

SPEND_NEGATIVE.title: Spend below zero
SPEND_NEGATIVE.explanation: A customer can't spend a negative amount. Please check the value.

SPEND_FORMAT.title: Spend with currency or comma
SPEND_FORMAT.explanation: Amounts are just the number, with a dot for cents. We remove the currency and fix the separators.
